map.技术动作比对：不同类型踢法（前踢/侧踢/旋踢/后踢/高踢）有不同高度系数，工具按: Technique comparison: different kick types (front / side / round / back / high) have different height coefficients, and the tool grades by adjusted height ratio for horizontal comparison.
map.安全提示：用于设定训练目标高度，避免过度追求高度拉伤；角度估算仅供参照，实际受髋: Safety note: use it to set training target height and avoid strains from chasing height; the angle estimate is reference only, and reality also depends on hip flexibility.
map.算例：170cm 身高、前踢离地 165cm: Worked example: 170 cm tall, front kick clearing 165 cm
map.：身高 170cm、腿长缺省=170×45%=76.5cm、踢高 165cm、前:
: height 170 cm, default leg length = 170 × 45% = 76.5 cm, kick height 165 cm, front kick (coefficient 1.0).
Height ratio = 165/170 × 100 = 97.1%; leg-length ratio = 165/76.5 × 100 = 215.7%; estimated angle = asin(165/(76.5+85)) × 180/π = asin(1.0) = 90.0° (the limit is reached and the formula truncates beyond it); adjusted height ratio = 97.1%/1.0 = 97.1% -> grade 'good' (at least 85%). This means a kick above head height is possible.
map.高度比和腿长比怎么理解？: How are the height ratio and leg-length ratio read?
map.高度比=踢高÷身高×100%，反映相对身高能踢多高；腿长比=踢高÷腿长×100%: Height ratio = kick height ÷ height × 100%, showing how high you can kick relative to your height; leg-length ratio = kick height ÷ leg length × 100%, showing how far past leg length you go. Combining the two avoids comparing only absolute height and ignoring body differences.
map.踢腿角度是怎么估算的？: How is the kick angle estimated?
map.按腿长与身高比例近似：角度=asin(踢高÷(腿长+半身高))。该式是简化模型，: Approximated from the leg-length to height ratio: angle = asin(kick height ÷ (leg length + half height)). This is a simplified model; actual kick angle also depends on hip flexibility and torso posture, so it is training reference only and you should not chase height blindly and risk a strain.
